span.p:
Already employed in an
IT-adjacent role (help desk,
NOC, sysadmin)?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does your employer have
a security team you could
laterally move toward?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sec. 2: build the evidence
a pipeline nominates for,
ask your manager directly

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sec. 2's evidence habits +
Sec. 5: external application
with a translated resume

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Coming from a non-IT
background with transferable
investigative skill?
(audit, military, teaching, etc.)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Can you afford 10-12 weeks
unpaid or reduced income
for a vetted apprenticeship?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sec. 3: vet and apply to a
program with a real
conversion gate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sec. 4: translate your own
experience, Sec. 5: external
application + referrals

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sec. 6: run the
equivalent-experience
self-scoring rubric

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Apply, using Part 5's
home-lab evidence and
Part 7's resume templates
to close remaining gaps
